prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic night photograph on a flooded last-train subway platform that opens into a moonlit reed river. An unmistakably adult woman serves as a Korean afterlife guide. An adult serves as a Korean afterlife guide through calm procedural responsibility, holding a closed destination ledger against her chest. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and understated natural styling follow the reference portrait. Use the uploaded portrait as the sole identity source. Keep her eye aperture, shape, and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, face length, lower-face and jaw width, cheekbones, skin tone, natural asymmetry, hairline, and adult age unchanged from that portrait while clothing, pose, lighting, and setting carry the transformation. In one wide full-body frame, one translucent deceased traveler remains beside the guide. The guide opens a luminous threshold door with her free hand and the traveler follows her gesture across it. Beside the doorway, the guide opens the threshold and the traveler follows her across the luminous passage, shoulder to shoulder at mid-stride. A transformed footprint marks passage across the boundary, changing from a wet shoeprint into reflected starlight at the doorway. An original contemporary Korean visual mechanism carries the role through contemporary dark layered clothing, a closed unlettered ledger, blank station signage, and invented water-and-starlight symbols. Foreground rainwater mirrors a midground threshold, while the reed river recedes behind both figures. Restrained silver rim light separates their linked action from the dark river reeds.
